amendments.when: after v1 was written, before any K metric was computed
amendments.reason: v1 geometry showed beta and Earth-view are collinear at the new-moon canonical epoch (Earth-view ~= 90 + beta for polar orbits; RAAN-root pairs differ by only ~10 deg). Added three polar cases at the nearest quarter-phase epoch (+6.85 d) where the beta -> Earth-view mapping flips. No existing case was moved or removed.
amendments.based_on: geometry only (beta, Earth-view, Sun-Earth separation); no f_perp or sigma_K existed

thresholds.delta: d = f_perp(case) - f_ref, absolute units of f_perp
thresholds.robustness: A gain class is claimed only if it holds, to at most one class lower, under the matched-observation-count variant AND at its predeclared validation neighbours.
thresholds.stage_effect_class: class of the stage's best matched-count case, with the within-stage f_perp range (max - min) reported alongside

predictions.G5_k_magnitude: The force is exactly linear in K (a = K g, lunar_od/srp.py), and the K column is dz/dK, which depends on K only through the negligible K-induced change of the linearisation trajectory.  Predicted BEFORE running: ||b_K||, f_perp, theta_K, I_K|x and absolute sigma_K are invariant to <1e-3 relative; sigma_K/K scales as 1/K.  Classification: INFORMATION_MAGNITUDE_ONLY (relative precision), not a direction change.
predictions.H2: f_perp falls as |beta| crosses the full-Sun boundary (C2)
predictions.H3: matched-|beta| face-on vs edge-on pairs differ in f_perp (C3)

rules.epoch: campaign manifest epoch for Sun, Earth position AND Earth rotation (consistent fixture)
rules.force_model: Moon point mass + lunar J2 (mean pole) + cannonball SRP with conical penumbra; mu_earth = mu_sun = 0 exactly as the canonical fixture; frozen (s17)
rules.tracking: two-way range, 3 DSN stations unless stated, 10 deg mask, 90 s cadence, 5 m sigma
rules.orbit_construction: circular (e = 0) in the lunar mean-equator frame at the canonical semi-major axis unless stated; argument of latitude 0 at epoch
rules.raan_root_rule: each (inclination, beta) has two RAAN roots; the PRIMARY case takes the root with the smaller RAAN in [0,360); G4 adds the other root as the matched partner
rules.fixed_duration: D = 15 canonical revolutions (the published W15 span)
rules.fixed_revolutions: 15 revolutions of the case's own Keplerian period
rules.matched_count: per stage: N_match = the minimum observation count over that stage's cases; each case keeps rows at round(linspace(0, N-1, N_match)) of its time-ordered rows
rules.G6_interaction_rule: run a 3x3 interaction surface of factor X with beta ONLY if stage X's effect class is MODERATE_DIRECTION_GAIN or stronger; otherwise G6 is empty
rules.validation_neighbours: for any case classed MODERATE or STRONG: beta +/-5 deg, or altitude x0.8 and x1.25, points not in this grid
rules.eclipse_counterfactual: ALWAYS run, analysis-only: identical orbits with the production shadow_model='NO_SHADOW' for G0-consistent, polar beta 0 and polar beta 20. Never a production default, never mission truth.
rules.jacobian_fd_arc: 4 revolutions of each geometry (same builder), step sweeps, floor-aware
rules.physical_validity: min altitude > 5 km over the arc, propagation success, finite states, period within 2% of Keplerian, finite illumination

cases.role: exact reproduction of the published W15 baseline
same beta as partner, quarter-phase epoch: Earth-view decoupled
